_comment: Site video registry. Source files live in media/ (never served). A video renders, and its files are copied into the deployed site by scripts/publish-media.cjs, ONLY when it is approved: approvedBy, approvedOn (YYYY-MM-DD), approvedSha256 equal to master.sha256 and to the sha256 of the file in media/ at build time, publishedOn (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it goes live; >= approvedOn and not in the future), a same-origin /media/ URL and captions in all eight languages. A replaced master breaks the checksum binding: the approval lapses and the build fails until a new approval is recorded. publishedOn is the VideoObject uploadDate. Review only: a Preview build with CAI_VIDEO_PREVIEW=1 (never Production) also shows 'pending-approval' videos whose file matches the master, behind a banner and without structured data. 'held' never renders. No third-party embeds. Review record: docs/media/video-integration-2026-11-27.md.
